column1: # Can a GIE model-level resource carry the index instead of HTTPRoute matches?
# mirror) matches the `model` field IN THE JSON BODY and rewrites it to weighted
#   spec.poolRef                    which InferencePool this applies to
#   spec.rules[].matches[].model    Exact match on the body's model field
# It matches the body, which is exactly what HTTPRoute cannot do. But it is scoped
# BY pool, so it applies only AFTER the request has reached one - it cannot answer
# "which pool owns this adapter", which is the question the ceiling exists for.
